name: Scholarships and Stipends
benefit: - **Scholarships:** ₹2,500/- per player is awarded to athletes who have won medals at the national level. - **Stipends:** ₹2,000/- per player is awarded to athletes who have participated at the national level, irrespective of winning.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a male. - The applicant should have participated in a national-level sports event. - The applicant should have won a medal at the national level to be eligible for the scholarship.
